`interface IShaderPass`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`BlurShaderPass`](/reference/shaders/blurshaderpass/), [`BorderShaderPass`](/reference/shaders/bordershaderpass/), [`CircleShaderPass`](/reference/shaders/circleshaderpass/), [`RoundedShaderPass`](/reference/shaders/roundedshaderpass/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.shader.pipeline` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [IShaderPass.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/shader/pipeline/IShaderPass.java)

One step of a `ShaderPipeline`, which binds a shader that reads the previous result as a texture.

## Description

Implement it for a shader effect of your own, or return it from the shader passes of a node effect.
JOID calls `bind`, draws the previous result as a textured quad over the area, then calls `unbind`, on the render thread.

## Method details

<a id="IShaderPass-method-bind"></a>

### bind

`void bind(ShaderPassContext context)` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

Binds your shader and sets its uniforms from `context`: the texel size, the area and its region on screen.
When the shader cannot draw, bind nothing: the quad is then drawn without a shader.

<a id="IShaderPass-method-unbind"></a>

### unbind

`void unbind()` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

Unbinds the shader bound in `bind`; JOID calls it even when the draw throws.

<a id="IShaderPass-method-expansion"></a>

### expansion

`float expansion()` <span class="joid-qualifier">default</span>

Returns how far, in design pixels, the pass draws outside the area, such as the radius of a blur; the area grows by the largest expansion of the passes.
`0F` by default.

<a id="IShaderPass-method-reach"></a>

### reach

`double reach(double scale)` <span class="joid-qualifier">default</span>

Returns how far, in screen pixels at the screen scale `scale`, the pass reads outside the visible part of the area, so that the pipeline renders that margin too.
By default the expansion times `scale`, plus one pixel.
